_readme: Golden cases: in-game measured numbers that pin the engine to reality.
Fill `expected` from actual game measurements (pip-boy damage card or hit
numbers vs a known target). Cases with `expected: null` are skipped.
conditions/enemyConditions patch the defaults from src/types/index.ts.

cases.name: Stock Fixer @50, no perks — pip-boy card damage
Fixer + Powerful Automatic Receiver @50 — pip-boy card damage
Shishkebab @45 cap, 15 STR — dual-component total (verifies split-damage curve semantics)
cases.source: user formula (72→64 per component: Shishkebab's max Eligible Level is 45, so (64×1.75)×2 — CONFIRM in-game that no lvl-50 Shishkebab exists; at 50 the curve would give 252)
